title: secure_block1_and_block2_roundtrip_replay_order_and_pivs fails with Blockwise(BlockOutOfOrder) (pre-existing)
description: Discovered while validating project-LICHEN-worker6-dowx: lichen-node/src/secure.rs:2568 test secure_block1_and_block2_roundtrip_replay_order_and_pivs fails with 'called Result::unwrap() on an Err value: Blockwise(BlockOutOfOrder)'. Verified pre-existing, NOT caused by the dowx announce-persistence work: reproduced at base commit 3b9e774cad with only the lib.rs duplicate-export compile fix applied (the crate does not compile at 3b9e774cad without it - see the merge 54e2c2cc5b which left a broken re-export for a nonexistent AnnouncePinFloor). Full lichen-node suite is otherwise green at the dowx commit (288 passed, this 1 failed). OSCORE blockwise transfer handles a replay/ordering scenario; failure appears unrelated to announce or RPL. Needs independent root-cause: either the test's blockwise expectations regressed when secure.rs changed (merge 54e2c2cc5b range) or the blockwise layer has an out-of-order handling bug. Failing test blocks a clean test gate on main.
close_reason: Phantom failure from shared cargo target/ race (documented pattern: shared-cargo-target-between-concurrent-workers). Test passes 5/5 deterministically at HEAD after cargo clean -p lichen-node. No code change needed — the stale binary from concurrent worker edits at 3b9e774cad produced the BlockOutOfOrder error. Full lichen-node suite: 358/359 pass (1 unrelated RPL failure in three_rpl_stacks_send_leaf_dao_via_preferred_parent).
